'''The Waste''' was a barren and scarred wasteland surrounding the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Gralleenya]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Questal/Legends|Questal]]. During the [[Ardanium Rush]], the land around Gralleenya was the first area searched, and within three years it was covered in [[Mining/Legends|mines]], caves and pits.
